_doc: SUT authorization-profile TEMPLATE (generic placeholders — no real SUT). Copy to .arta/authz_profile/<project_id>.json and edit for a SUT. The authz_discovery engine is fully generic; this profile only RENAMES its structural output to the SUT's own taxonomy. Every field is OPTIONAL — omit any and the neutral default applies. NEVER commit a real SUT's profile (it is config-layer DATA; .arta/ is gitignored).

scope_tiers._doc: map a path CONTAINER segment (the segment that owns an id param, e.g. `organizations` in /organizations/{orgId}/...) to this SUT's scope-tier label. Containers not listed fall back to the container name uppercased.

domain_aliases._doc: normalise a permission-prefix, e.g. the `organizations` container -> `org.` so permissions read org.members.read.
